notes:
Summary: Late-stage procurement, strong product fit for clinical chat bot + embedding search. Main blocker: data residency.

Key points (bullets from AE notes):
- 2024-09-18 intro call (AE/SE): discovery showed high value for clinical-trial support and document search. Attendees: Head of AI (Luc Moreau), CISO (Anja Petersen), Cloud Ops (Sven Koller). ff_2024-09-18_emedidata_intro.
- 2024-10-01 demo: ran hosted-demo with sample datasets; performance and accuracy praised. Asking for private/VPC due to PHI.
- 2024-10-22 security deep-dive: security team asked for EU-only residency guarantee and legal clauses preventing cross-border egress. CISO quoted: "We cannot risk any tokens leaving EU jurisdiction — regulators will not allow." ff_2024-10-22_security_review.
- 2024-10-28 procurement update: internal champion (Head of AI) moved to another role; champion gone, momentum dropped.
- 2024-11-01 procurement update from procurement: paused due to budget reforecast; also vendor requires EU-only SLA which Redwood cannot confirm for private hosted package today.
- 2024-11-03 lost to competitor: CobaltCloud offered EU-only dedicated region and contract language acceptable to legal. Buyer notified AE via gmail thread-0c3ea2b.

POC/technical notes:
- POC used med-docs subset, embeddings + reranking pipeline. Latency target: <120ms median for short queries, throughput 200 qps during peak.
- Cost sensitivity moderate; willing to pay premium for EU-only compliance.
- Preferred models: open Llama-family quantized variants or Redwater-curated open models; customer open to quantization/optimize suggestions.

Next steps attempted: multiple follow-ups, shared security FAQ and legal appendix (drive links), SE attempted to scope on-prem appliance but legal insisted on EU-hosted region + contract clause.

Outcome: Closed-lost — primary reason: data residency requirement (EU-only) not met by Redwood's private offering at time of procurement. Other contributors: loss of internal champion and procurement budget freeze. Notes contain fragments of email replies and call quotes.
